messages:
anika: Quick sync — Aurora private beta target 06/10. Need cross-team agreement on launch gates: KMS/HSM, staging capacity, canary plan, perf SLOs. Who can take the extra scope?

diego: Runtime note: quantized v1 is functional but shows ~2x latency variance on long prompts. I need ~2w for perf tuning + a perf regression suite.

priya: Infra: to hit Aurora qps we should reserve a Dedicated pool ~4x A100-eq for prewarm + baseline. Cost estimate ~ $10k/mo. Also need VPC peering + route updates.

marcus: Security: Helios-style requirement — customer wants HSM-backed keys for any PII. That’s an enterprise ent ticket + approval. If HSM not ready, we need a no-PII beta scope or legal signoff.

katelyn: SRE canary proposal: start 3% traffic for 2h, if errors <0.5% and p95 <200ms then 10% for 4h, then 25%. Auto-rollback on >1% errors or p95 >250ms. Playbook + runbook to be drafted.

anika: Product tradeoff: can we scope down feature set for beta? e.g., remove structured outputs and advanced reranking to reduce runtime complexity. That would make infra and runtime cheaper/safer.

diego: Removing structured-output path saves a custom decoupler — ~30% inference CPU. That would definitely reduce perf risk for beta.

priya: If structured-output is dropped, we can go to 3x A100-eq for beta and still have a safe buffer. I'll update capacity PR if we agree.

marcus: Even with reduced scope, HSM for PII still stands. If HSM timeline slips past 06/10, two options: (A) run a no-PII beta, (B) delay GA. Helios signed NDA — need to confirm their PII tolerance.

anika: Decision needed here: 1) Delay 2w to secure HSM + perf tuning, or 2) Proceed 06/10 with no-PII beta + strict monitoring, or 3) Drop features to fit HSM & perf by 06/10. Please cast quick votes.

katelyn: Vote: proceed with no-PII beta + tight canary and monitoring. Escalate to eng lead if customer insists on HSM.

diego: Vote: prefer delay 2w — runtime perf risk is non-trivial and I want the perf suite green.

priya: Vote: drop structured output and go 06/10 with reduced capacity + no-PII. Infra leaning to the ship-it side if runtime signs off.

anika: OK noting votes: mixed. Action items: Priya -> capacity PR for 3x A100-eq by EOD; Diego -> create perf test job + regression checklist; Marcus -> open ent ticket for HSM + check legal; Katelyn -> draft canary playbook & rollback thresholds.

priya: Infra PR opened: https://git.redwood/infra/pr/314 (cost breakdown + prewarm plan). Tagging budget owner.

deploy-bot: heads-up: scheduled staging maintenance 06/08 02:00-04:00 UTC — prewarm may be affected.

anika: Thanks — I'll confirm with Aurora PM about PII acceptance. If they require HSM, we'll either delay or scope GA to HSM-only.

katelyn: :thumbsup: I'll drop a skeleton playbook and include exact metrics/alert signals.

diego: I'll run a 48h perf job starting Thursday night with the typical prompt corpus. If p95 <200ms and variance <20% we can be comfortable.

marcus: HSM ent ticket opened, ETA 06/06 for initial approval. Looping legal.

anika: Great. Reconvene 06/06 10:00 PT. Agenda: HSM status, perf pass/fail, infra PR approval, final canary doc. Thanks all
